title: 36 Hours in Austin, Texas
abstract: Beyond the SXSW festival, there’s classic barbecue, contemporary art and even a beer garden on a working ranch.

title: 36 Hours in Zurich
abstract: To a yearlong celebration of the centenary of Dada, you can add first-rate restaurants, Art Deco bars and a lake cruise with views of the Alps.

title: 36 Hours in Mexico City
abstract: The Mexican capital is more cosmopolitan than ever, with world-class museums, vibrant street art, top-notch restaurants and bustling markets.

title: 36 Hours in Hong Kong
abstract: A booming art scene and exciting culinary endeavors keep ever-changing Hong Kong in the spotlight.

title: 36 Hours in Galway, Ireland
abstract: Welcoming and walkable and filled to the brim with old-fashioned pubs and excellent seafood restaurants, scenic Galway may be Ireland’s most charming city.
